pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Window Splitter (variable): each separator is a focusable role=separator whose value is the size of the pane before it in percent; arrow keys move it, Home and End go to the limits, Enter collapses and restores.

aria.value: size of the pane before it, 0 to 100
limits from min, max, and the neighbor's limits (min 0 when collapsible)
'{label}, collapsed' while the pane before it is collapsed
vertical for horizontal splitters, horizontal for vertical ones
id of the pane before it
the label of the pane before it (the primary pane)

keyboard.action: Each separator is a tab stop between the panes' content.
Move by step pixels (mirrored in RTL).
Smallest or largest allowed size of the pane before it.
Collapse the collapsible pane next to it, or restore it.

focus: Separators are focusable (tabindex 0); dragging focuses the separator, so keyboard and pointer share one current separator. Collapsing never moves focus.
notes: Every drag can be done with the keyboard (WCAG 2.5.7 dragging movements).
The grip is a shape cue besides the line color; its color meets 3:1 against the surface.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
